overall_rule: Every scored gate must pass; partial is fail. A required cue hidden by occlusion, a blocked render, or insufficient pixel evidence is unscored and never a pass.
retry_policy: one authorized built-in image generation call; no retry

gates.requirement: The worn cropped jacket visibly combines metallic silver fabric and translucent iridescent PVC sleeve panels.
gates.pass_condition: Both materials visibly differ on the same garment.

gates.requirement: Cropped fitted upper garment, low-rise cargo trousers with side pockets, and thick-soled platform boots form one visible outfit.
gates.pass_condition: All three silhouette elements are visible from upper body through footwear.

gates.requirement: Narrow violet-tinted wraparound glasses on the forehead and a translucent belt with polished oval chrome hardware.
gates.pass_condition: Tinted narrow glasses and clear/chrome belt hardware are recognizable on the subject.

gates.requirement: The millennium-futurist cue cluster is carried by the subject outfit and accessories.
gates.pass_condition: The subject alone, without the technical background, visibly carries the material, silhouette, and accessory gates.

gates.requirement: Only observed facial cues guide the newly generated adult subject.
gates.pass_condition: Dark brown eyes, tapered facial outline, slender straight nose, softly rounded pale-pink lips are visible with the face unobscured; identity is not scored.

gates.requirement: Actor-relative right hand grips the side handwheel of the star-projector pedestal and actor-relative left hand rests on the stationary bench brace.
gates.pass_condition: Both connected arms and both distinct contacts are visible; the wheel belongs to the projector mechanism.

gates.requirement: Twin perforated spherical projector heads on a mechanical pedestal visibly produce a field of star pinpoints across a curved test wall.
gates.pass_condition: Projector morphology, mechanically connected wheel, and projected star field on curved wall are readable in one frame.

gates.requirement: Balanced standing adult, complete equipment, face, both hands, belt, and boots appear in the selected slightly elevated control-side front three-quarter view.
gates.pass_condition: Body-part ownership, joint paths, reach, support and spatial separation remain plausible and visible.
